hypothesis: Measured incumbent-adjacent K choices expose at least one legal byte/fidelity/runtime tradeoff without an unmeasured fallback.
falsifier: No adjacent option has measured decode+prefill routes, deterministic payloads, and a finite direct fidelity/resource observation.

decision_rules.accept: Retain only measured legal options with complete route/resource and direct-fidelity evidence.
decision_rules.reject: Reject any modeled route, fallback, nonfinite result, or failed parity gate.
decision_rules.futility: Stop an option family when all adjacent rungs are dominated or invalid.
decision_rules.abort: Abort on GPU error, OOM, identity drift, or reserve violation.
